notes: Normal images contain no signal handlers, write instrumentation or injected wait.
Diagnostic images add 25ms before each real Sync only in timed posting phase. Sync wall time is not HTTP latency.
Mixed CPU includes concurrent reads. Fixed count includes all attempted work through drain.
Pre-restart optional snapshot is captured after stopping the timed process with a 35s grace period and before starting it; final optional_shutdown covers only the last process.
All trials including late work, errors and unissued work are retained.
No live BBS data, image, edge, certificates, WAF or host storage parameters changed.
Pure body preparation is enabled only with >=8 posts, >=2 CPUs, shared body WAL and <=256KiB canonical frame bytes; existing reservations and 64frame/8MiB budgets unchanged.
Trace overlap is wall time, not CPU time; actual Sync intervals exclude injected wait.
Candidate SIGKILL HTTP container run not performed; app/store process-crash and fault tests are separate evidence.
All trial processes saved every accepted optional log with zero loss; mixed pre-restart snapshot includes preparation and recovery.
decision: rejected: bounded CPU preparation overlaps actual Sync, but posting tail-latency improvement was not reproducible; product Go restored to baseline
